title: Market entry management for pharmaceutical manufacturers | Nazryx
description: Launch into frontier markets with the registrations in your name. Nazryx registers your products, appoints the importer, reaches the doctors and bids in state rounds.

sections.title: Launch into new markets.
sections.accent: Keep the registrations in your name.
sections.lede: Entering a frontier market is a sequence of decisions: which products, which market, which route, which partners. We make them with you, from evidence, and then run the launch on the ground.

sections.title: Most launches are decided
sections.lede: Get the order right and the market opens. Get it wrong and you lose a year and a dossier.

items.title: Choose on evidence
items.text: Which products have room, and which markets will pay, is already in the data. We read it before you commit.

items.title: Sequence the route
items.text: National or regional, which market first, which products in which wave. The order decides the timeline.

items.title: Own the market
items.text: Registrations in your name, partners you can replace. The position you build stays yours.

sections.title: Four phases.
sections.lede: What we do, what we need from you, what you receive, and how long it typically takes.

items.title: Read the market
items.text: We assess your portfolio against each target market and agree where to start.
cols: Assess each product's competition, price position and demand in each market.
Your product list, dosage forms and strengths, and your certificates.
A market read: what's open, thin or crowded, and a recommended launch order.

items.title: Register
items.text: We choose the route, prepare the local part of the dossier and follow the filing through.
cols: Choose the route, translate and complete the local dossier, file, answer the regulator, and coordinate any plant inspection.
Your dossier and plant documentation for the products you take forward.
Registrations held in your name, with a clear timeline for each.

items.title: Launch
items.text: We bring in the right partners and buyers so the product is ready to sell from approval.
cols: Appoint and vet the importer, secure listings with pharmacy chains, and prepare state bids.
A launch plan with partners, listings and volumes by year.

items.title: Grow
items.text: We stay on the account: doctors, prices, reorders and reporting.
cols: Reach the doctors who prescribe, keep pricing right, bid in state rounds and track reorders.
Stock and marketing support as agreed.
A written report every week: orders, stock, listings, what to push and what to fix.

items.title: 20-minute call
items.text: Your portfolio, certificates and target markets.

items.title: Market read
items.text: Your catalogue against each target market.

items.title: Proposal
items.text: Products, filing waves, route, launch plan and volumes by year.

items.title: First sales
items.text: Depending on the market and the route.

items.label: Nazryx
items.title: Your local representative
items.text: We act for you in the market. Never the holder; we never take title to stock.

items.label: The importer
items.title: Stocks and sells
items.text: Appointed with you, and replaceable without losing anything.

items.title: Commission on sales
items.text: Where we run the market for you, our commission is tied to what you sell.

items.title: Fees for defined work
items.text: Market reads, registration and monitoring are fee-based work, scoped and agreed up front.

items.title: Exclusive partnerships
items.text: A few manufacturers at a time, each with real work in market.

sections.title: Start with the market read.
sections.text: Send your product list and the markets you are curious about. We will show you what is open before we talk about an agreement.
